rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior act of knowing
object of knowing; compound of hidden and true nature
main verb indicating emergence of the resulting state

items.question: What state arises from realizing the hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
That hidden true nature can be directly known.
All-knowingness arises as a result of such knowing.
items.inference: Realizing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
